Glen Berman

I study things called Artificial Intelligence and their relationship to the production of scientific knowledge.

I'm a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at MetaMelb, University of Melbourne. I live in Melbourne (Naarm), Australia.

Things I'm writing about at the moment

  • The arc of metascience. I'm working on a genealogy of metascience, as part of a larger ARC Discovery Project led by Fiona Fidler and Kate Williams.
  • AI interventions in metascience. Kate Williams and I are working on an experimental scoping review of proposals for, and critiques of, AI interventions in metascience.
  • Resistance and industrialised cognition. I'm writing a follow up to my paper on epistemic extractivism, exploring possibilities for remediating AI technologies.

Other writing

  • A country case study of metascience in Australia, written with Fallon Mody, Peter Hayes, Kate Williams, and Fiona Fidler, as part of the Research on Research Institute's Seize the Meta-Moment project.
  • A short commentary on the metaphor of GenAI as an epistemic carcinogen, published in AI & Society.
  • A personal reflection on Jewish safety, published in The Guardian after the 2025 Bondi attack.

Other projects

  • AI as Infrastructure is a small project James Smithies and I have been working on. We've developed ATLAS, an open-source harness for evaluating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over archival and cultural collections (described in a paper in Cambridge Forum on AI: Culture and Society), and through workshops with practitioners have produced a number of Responsible AI resources.
  • I used to work in social change organisations. These days, I contribute through my role as Chair of the Board at GetUp, one of the largest campaign organisations in Australia with over a million members fighting for a fair, flourishing, and just Australia.
